description.en: Updated for 2026, this is the full price list for Taj City in New Cairo, developed by Madinet Masr — apartments, townhouses and administrative offices for sale in Taj City compound, on the Suez Road facing Cairo Airport, minutes from Heliopolis and the First Settlement, with sizes from 50 to 177 sqm. answer.en: Taj City offers apartments, townhouses, and offices. The closest option to a villa is the 155 sqm townhouse in Origami Golf starting from EGP 20.2M.

description.en: D2N is the first commercial launch in Madinet Masr's history — 65 years of building residential communities have created a deep understanding of resident needs. Today, that understanding becomes an integrated commercial project serving hundreds of thousands directly on Al-Amal axis.

description.en: Administrative offices and medical clinics for sale at Day To Night (D2N), inside Sarai Compound by Madinet Masr in New Cairo. Units range from 46 to 180 sqm with prices starting at EGP 7,200,000 — a commercial investment set inside a 1,250-acre residential community with a built-in customer base. Payment starts at 10% down with installments up to 15 years and cash discounts of up to 58%.
